description: This Java class defines a color settings page for Android Logcat in an IDE, including syntax highlighting and display configurations.

classes.name: AndroidLogcatColorPage
classes.description: Implements a color settings page for Android Logcat highlighting in an IDE.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the color settings page.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon associated with the color settings page.

methods.name: getAttributeDescriptors
methods.description: Provides the attribute descriptors for different log levels.

methods.name: getColorDescriptors
methods.description: Provides color descriptors, empty in this implementation.

methods.name: getDemoText
methods.description: Provides sample logcat text with tags for syntax highlighting.

methods.name: getAdditionalHighlightingTagToDescriptorMap
methods.description: Returns the map of tags to text attribute keys for highlighting.
